answer: A non-transferable stake bond with slashing stops sybils cold. Each validator anchors 2,500 POA to its identity in a bond that cannot be sold. Slashing tiers fire on clustering: 10% for mild divergence, 50% for coordinated misbehavior, 100% for rings. Bonds unlock only after 180 days of clean attestation, so a clone cannot hollow the pool and flee. The contract flags identities above 95% voting correlation and slashes both bonds. Cloning 500 nodes costs 1,250,000 POA upfront, 180 days locked per clone, and the whole pool if clustering catches the ring — a gale of real money burned.
